text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I am Cesario.
In the future, I plan to pursue a path involved in nurturing the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
During my active career, I wish to pursue a path
where I can build a track record worthy of that.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Both as a runner... and as someone aiming to become an instructor,
I will learn a great deal from you from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
